description: Canonical operation contract for multi-modality ingestion, lifecycle state separation, and invalidation rules.

CAPTURING.description: Source audio actively spooled to PCM stream; separate from ASR readiness.

ASR_READY.description: Local acoustic model loaded and ready to process audio segments.

STOP_REQUESTED.description: Stop signaled to recording host; tail audio flushing in progress.

CAPTURE_STOPPED.description: Source-bound PCM audio flushed, verified, and sealed.

SEALED_PREVIEW.description: Interim transcript generated for live preview; not an ingestion deliverable.

ATTRIBUTION_PENDING.description: Diarization or speaker ambiguity requires operator resolution.

PACKAGE_READY.description: Source artifacts extracted, verified, and packaged; awaiting authorization.

PARTIAL.description: Selective regeneration (e.g. output3-only) succeeded for requested deliverable; full artifact coverage remains partial.

PUBLISHED_UNVERIFIED.description: Graph mutations committed to shadow/staging store; readback verification pending.

COMPLETE.description: All modality-required deliverables produced, quality gates passed, and independent publication/coverage readback verified.

LIVE_RECORDING.dependency_and_evidence_contract: Capture and ASR readiness separate; authoritative master audio and verified handoff on stop.

FINALIZED_TRANSCRIPT.dependency_and_evidence_contract: Validate/freeze 01, then permit 02 and 03 in parallel from that same 01; preserve source/speaker evidence.

MEETING_NOTES.dependency_and_evidence_contract: Both derive from notes; no invented verbatim transcript or timestamps.

WRITTEN_DOCUMENT.dependency_and_evidence_contract: Direct document evidence and locations; no forensic/recap executor.

SELECTIVE_MEETING_REGENERATION.dependency_and_evidence_contract: Keeps original meeting modality; partial operation cannot claim all-output ingestion completion.

MIXED_SOURCE_SET.dependency_and_evidence_contract: Primary spoken source remains distinct from documentary attachments; each source has digest, rights, locations and coverage.

LIVE_COPILOT_QUERY.dependency_and_evidence_contract: Governed read-only grounding/abstention and its own operation budget.

permitted_effects: selective regeneration of 03 deliverable while preserving MEETING modality

prohibited_effects: disabling gates on AUDIO or MEETING_TRANSCRIPT
permitted_effects: explicitly validated DOCUMENT or MEETING_NOTES routes only

prohibited_effects: any dispatch to external cloud ASR backends; strictly zero cloud dispatch
capping live recording duration, local ASR chunks, diarization, or copilot
permitted_effects: provisional pilot cap strictly for positively bound DOCUMENT final synthesis
